title: SIU called in after man shot by cops
article: A Toronto man armed with a knife was killed in a confrontation with police in Scarborough Saturday, the province's Special Investigations Unit said.
Toronto Police officers responded to a call on Adanac Dr., near Eglinton Ave. E. and Bellamy Rd., shortly before 6 p.m., the SIU said.
The man, who the SIU said was armed with a knife, was shot more than once during a confrontation with police. He was rushed to Sunnybrook hospital where he was pronounced dead.
Five of its investigators have been assigned to the case, the SIU said.
The SIU probes all interactions between police and members of the public that result in death, serious injuries or allegations of sexual assault.
Anyone who has information regarding this incident should contact the SIU's lead investigator at 416-622-2150 or 1-800-787-8529, ext. 2150.
